review_type: Read-only static patch review. No simulator, ROS node, new dependency installation, or production test execution performed.
conclusion: NO_BLOCKING_STATIC_FINDING: suitable to proceed to the mandatory fresh runtime retest. This is not a PASS result for execution or final acceptance.

confirmed_patch_properties.finding: Initial SIGINT targets only the ros2 launch parent PID, allowing Jazzy to forward it once. Group SIGTERM/SIGKILL escalation remains bounded and is treated as a failure. Both named launch business children must have explicit clean exit code 0; parent exit alone cannot satisfy cleanup.

Process groups are created by this runner and inspected for remaining live members. CLI daemons are deferred to domain-specific shutdown. Cleanup exceptions/remaining owned processes set final result FAIL and raise; they do not leave a completed PASS summary.

Spawn records include cwd, expanded command, PID/group, start/end observation times, whitelisted environment, signals, log path and launch-child exit outcomes. Explicit env assignments for the missing-model subprocess are reflected in the recorded whitelist.

Observation wrappers invoke each original reset/step exactly once and leave returned physics data unchanged. send_response completion is logged after the real send method returns. Same _sample read_state results are paired with the exact returned message timestamp; no extra physics operation or later-state comparison was added.

Ordering requires real send_end < reset_begin < reset_end < first step_begin. Rejected callbacks preserve episode/reset-count/control-steps/busy/pending/environment ID. Readback compares names/q/dq exactly before calculating and reporting measured absolute errors; unmatched/no samples cannot fabricate zero error.

sample_created events detect new sampling after the observed terminal event; this is distinct from delayed delivery of already published messages. Actual completed control calls and physics-step counts are retained for the instrumented run.

Original launch, real CLI calls, graph/type checks, normal and wall timeouts, same-instance retry, active launch Ctrl+C and invalid zero/negative episode timeout startup checks remain real cross-process scenarios. Synthetic step fault is clearly labeled.

210 s internal deadline, 1 s discovered-client RPC threshold, normal 20 s simulation/30 s wall budget and 3 s independent wall budget remain unchanged. Extra active-shutdown scenario adds work without silently widening budgets.

README matches the reviewed controlled draft. It declares reused system packages and shared-site venv scope, creates the new venv explicitly, uses a separately downloaded pinned model and unified new build/install/log paths, and removes source-specific absolute paths from current ROS reproduction commands.

nonblocking_caveats.finding: Some final evidence aggregation precedes executor/node/context teardown without its own try guard: missing left_knee_joint in otherwise valid messages or a log-file I/O error can raise before later context cleanup and final summary write. Existing fixed model names and readable run-owned logs make this inapplicable to the expected valid run, but an error must not be reported as COMPLETE.
nonblocking_caveats.recommendation: If encountered, preserve the actual nonzero/incomplete run and perform owned-process cleanup in the outer driver; optional future hardening would isolate aggregation failures and put context/stream cleanup in unconditional finally. No runtime repair is required merely for this hypothetical case.

nonblocking_caveats.finding: Ownership inference for the CLI daemon relies on domain isolation and the recorded pre-run daemon state. Final report must still cross-check outer preflight and post-run process inventory; static code review cannot prove the domain was unoccupied.

Pending-before-reset busy rejection is still a logical unit-test claim. The real reset-window request may only be handled after single-threaded reset returns. Report its sent interval and measured response latency accurately, without claiming concurrent preemption.

The supplementary readback/order scenario uses the existing 2.003 s simulation timeout. Its observed wrappers prove server ordering and true same-sample state readback; they should not be described as an uninstrumented original launch.

The tested README intentionally retains an awaiting-results paragraph. Replace it with actual final measurements and evidence links before publication, recording this final reporting-only difference from the tested draft. Preserve all historical values and failed root1 cleanup evidence.

syntax_check: ast.parse of reviewed runner succeeded without importing ROS or simulation code.
runtime_gate: Parent must complete fresh root2 installation, build, explicit runner and regression; inspect actual child exits, watchdog code, final result/cleanup errors and remaining owned process inventory. Static review does not waive any gate.
